stem.text: An organometallic lithium compound, $\text{RLi}$, contains the nucleophile $\text{R}^{-}$.
$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{Li}$ reacts with pentan-2-one. The mechanism is nucleophilic addition. The first step produces an anion which is then protonated to form the final product.

A.alt: Skeletal formula: five-carbon chain with OH on the second carbon from one end.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: six-carbon chain with OH and a methyl branch both on the third carbon.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: five-carbon chain with OH and a methyl branch both on the second carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: straight carbon chain with OH on a carbon near the middle.
